info.title: API.SH: PitchBook
info.description: The PitchBook API from API.SH: public PitchBook data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company's PitchBook profile preview as a logged-out visitor sees it: name, logo, description, website, social links, corporate office, year founded, status (private/public), employees, latest deal type and amount, investor count, former names, ownership and financing status, primary and other industries, verticals; the valuation and funding table (deal type, date, amount, stage), competitors, investors, investments and acquisitions, exits and affiliates (each with the total the site states and the rows it shows, usually 5-10, with profile links), the patents summary and recent patents, related PitchBook news and research, and the FAQs. Values PitchBook reserves for its subscribers come back as null. Use /pitchbook/v1/search to find an id.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pitchbook-company

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The company's PitchBook id (the part after /profiles/company/ in its link), e.g. `54782-29`, or a pitchbook.com/profiles/company/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Companies, investors and funds whose name matches, in the order PitchBook's profile search lists them (15 per page): name, type (company, investor or fund), id for /pitchbook/v1/company, /investor or /fund, link and logo. `last_page` is the highest page the site links to. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pitchbook-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
